title: Apple Overvalued? Here's What Else You Can Get for the Price
text: For this purchase price, the prospective investor could own any of the following Apple-equivalents: Coca-Cola ( KO ) + Boeing ( BA ) Nike ( NKE ) + Kraft ( KFT ) + Nokia ( NOK ) + Disney ( DIS ) McDonald's ( MCD ) + Intel ( INTC ) Pepsico ( PEP ) + ConocoPhillips ( COP ) Hewlett Packard ( HPQ ) + 3M ( MMM ) Cisco Systems ( CSCO ) + Texas Instruments ( TXN ) Take your pick. In response to my Amazon post , there have been several comments about Apple ( AAPL ). No stranger to momentum, Jim Cramer seems to think it's worth $300 a share.
